text.tspan: 3.1 CREATE A GROUP AND BROWSE GROUPS (YC06, YC07)
An Admin may also create a group, with topic and supervisor and no Leader
3.2 ADMIN EDITS A GROUP, ADDS A MEMBER, CHANGES THE LEADER (YC11, YC20)

g.text: [Already in a group or group full (5)]

text.tspan: POST /api/v1/groups/{id}/leader and PATCH /api/v1/groups/{id}/leader do the same
[Not an active member of the group]
[Caller is not this group's Leader or an Admin]
3.4 LOCK THE ROSTER AND SEND IT FOR APPROVAL (YC16, YC19)

svg.text: 409 You already belong to a group
Save group (FORMED, roster DRAFT, code GRP-xxxxxx if empty)
Add creator as Leader (role GROUP_LEADER), cancel their other pending requests
201 Group (the creator is Leader, size 1 of 5)
Look for a group to join
Groups still recruiting with fewer than 5 members
Update group, replace Leader if leaderUserId is given
Add or reactivate the member row, cancel their pending requests
400 The new leader must be an active member
Old Leader becomes member, new member becomes Leader
400 Ask an Admin to replace the Leader
Member status REMOVED, roster back to DRAFT
locked = true (lockedByAdmin = true when an Admin locks)
400 Say why the roster is rejected
rosterStatus = APPROVED or REJECTED, outbox event ROSTER_REVIEWED
